18. Events after the reporting period

HUMAIN

On November 1, 2026, Saudi Aramco announced the closing of a transaction with the Public Investment Fund (“PIF”) for the acquisition

of a 49% stake each in Al-Mustaqbal Lil-Thaka Al-Istinai Company and HUMAIN Limitless Fund LP (collectively, “HUMAIN”) through a

wholly-owned subsidiary, with PIF retaining 51% ownership in both companies.
